title: Standard proposal v1
description: config/standard/proposals/<id>.json (PADRAO-DEV F1c): a proposal to change the development standard (a PROP of the engineering model). The rule challenges of docs/process/rule-challenges/ are read as proposals where they are; this file is for a proposal that has no other home.

statement.description: What the proposal changes and why.

state.description: open: written; warning: its change runs as a warning while it is measured; decided: a decision accepted it; applied: the standard changed; rejected.

changes.description: The rules or versions it changes.

deadline.description: The date by which it is decided.
